<img src="../fig/self.png" class="profile-photo" alt="Hisashi Takeda">

::: {.tagline}
Professor, Institute for Data Science Education, Tokyo International University<br>
Founder, TAKEDATA ANALYTICS LLC

I work on forecasting electricity load, renewable generation, and power market prices.
::: 

## From statistical models to production systems

I have spent more than twenty years on electricity load forecasting — designing the
statistical models, and also building the systems that run them in utility operations.

## Practice and theory together

I earned a doctorate in statistical science while working on operational problems at a
utility research institute, publishing ensemble data-assimilation methods for forecasting
in peer-reviewed international journals. I now teach and research at a university while
bringing forecasting technology into practice through the company I founded.

## Forecasts that reach the people who need them

I design and build the whole path — from ingesting numerical weather prediction through
to the delivery platform — for load, solar, wind, and price forecasts.
